tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MAXSUN MS-Challenger Z890M WIFI Motherboard

The MAXSUN MS-Challenger Z890M WIFI is a high-performance micro-ATX motherboard designed to support Intel's latest Core Ultra processors. It combines cutting-edge technology with robust features, making it an excellent choice for gamers, content creators, and professionals seeking a reliable and powerful computing solution.​


Key Features

  • Intel LGA1851 Socket: Supports Intel Core Ultra processors, ensuring compatibility with the latest CPU technologies.​
  • Intel Z890 Chipset: Provides advanced platform capabilities, including enhanced memory support and improved connectivity options.​
  • Dual-Channel DDR5 Memory: Equipped with 2 DIMM slots supporting up to 128GB of DDR5 RAM, with overclocking capabilities up to 7200 MHz, delivering exceptional memory performance.​
  • PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot: Offers high-speed data transfer rates, ideal for next-generation graphics cards and expansion cards.​
  • Dual M.2 Slots: One PCIe 5.0 x4/x2 M.2 slot and one PCIe 4.0 x4/x2 M.2 slot, supporting 2242/2280/22110 form factors, providing ample storage options for SSDs.​
  • 3 SATA 6Gb/s Ports: Allows additional storage devices to be connected, accommodating various storage needs.​
  • Realtek ALC897 Audio Codec: Delivers high-quality audio output, enhancing the overall multimedia experience.​
  • Realtek RTL8125BG/D 2.5G Ethernet: Ensures fast and stable wired network connectivity for online gaming and data transfer.​
  • Intel AX101 Wi-Fi 6 & Bluetooth 5.2: Provides next-generation wireless connectivity, offering faster speeds and improved range for seamless internet access and peripheral connections.​
  • USB Connectivity: Includes a USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C front header, USB 3.2 Gen 1 headers, and multiple USB 3.2 & 2.0 ports, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of peripherals.​
  • ARGB and NRGB Headers: Supports customizable lighting options, allowing users to personalize their system's aesthetics.​
  • Comprehensive Cooling Support: Features multiple fan headers, including CPU, PUMP, and SYS_FAN headers, to maintain optimal system temperatures.​
  • Convenience Features: Equipped with a front COM port header and a CLR CMOS button for easy system setup and maintenance.​
